theme: intake create gate CANCREATE + UMASK private plate mask

weaknesses.title: UMASK is process-scoped — lost across cubalc invocations
weaknesses.detail: Action dispatch re-execs binary each time. mask then seed in separate runs does not apply private mask unless seed re-sets via ARG2/ENV. Agents assume durable umask like CHMOD.
weaknesses.repro: mask 0077; new process seed → host default umask

weaknesses.title: UMASK set returns previous mask not newly applied
weaknesses.detail: SYS UMASK 0077 → LAST=0022 (old). Agents that print LAST as current mis-stamp plates. Must GETUMASK after set.

weaknesses.title: WRITE overwrite keeps prior mode — umask only on create
weaknesses.detail: Re-seed existing path does not re-apply umask. Board must RM then WRITE for private mode proof. No WRITECREATE or FORCE_CREATE flag.

weaknesses.title: MODE_N decimal vs UMASK_N vs octal strings triple trap
weaknesses.detail: 0600 → MODE_N=384; 0077 → UMASK_N=63. Agents compare numeric 600/77 and fail.

weaknesses.title: CANCREATE silent 0 on missing parent vs empty path OK=0
weaknesses.detail: Bad parent: OK=1 LAST_N=0. Empty path: OK=0 sticky ERR. Same dual as CANREAD family — agents need two branches.

weaknesses.title: HAS on umask/mode strings is digit false-friend
weaknesses.detail: HAS 0077 "7" → 1; HAS 0600 "600" may glue poorly. No bit-mask expected-mode helper (0666 & ~umask).

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: ACTIVE path and short VAL glue in cat -A.

workarounds: Co-locate UMASK set with WRITE in same process (ARG2/ENV on seed)
GETUMASK after SET to stamp current mask
RM existing before private seed so umask applies
language_gaps: Session/process-persistent umask plate or auto CUBALC_UMASK env apply
UMASK set LAST=new option or dual PREV/CUR vars
WRITECREATE / CREATEONLY that always applies umask
Unified empty vs denied probe contract
issues_faced: cross-run umask loss forced same-process A2 mask on seed
overwrite mode sticky without RM — core lesson
selftest 256/256; no language fix this iter
